curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why crossings demand care, active versus passive crossings, the signs and signals and where to stop, who must always stop, and what to do if you stall on the tracks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each crossing rule; contrast cards on gated versus gateless crossings and the stalled-vehicle steps.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a crossing and asking what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover what an expressway is and its speed limits, entering from full ramps and stub lanes, changing lanes and exiting, and staying sharp at high speed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for expressway basics, entering and exiting; a contrast card on full ramps versus stub lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on entering, exiting and missing an exit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why night driving needs extra caution, when headlights are required, and when to dim high beams.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for night caution, headlight law and dimming rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when headlights are required and when to dim.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover wet roads and hydroplaning, headlights and fog lamps in bad weather, preparing for winter, and handling skids.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for wet roads, weather lights, winter prep and skids; contrast cards on high versus low beams and rear versus front skids.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing weather or a skid and asking what to do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain deer-crash patterns and defenses, then the step-by-step responses to blowouts, steering and brake failure, dead headlights, stuck throttles, leaving the pavement and head-on threats.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for deer and each emergency; a contrast card on brake failure versus steering failure.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming an emergency and asking for the first move.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover escaping a car stalled on tracks with a train coming, a car in water, smoke from the hood and blocked vision, then the chapter's review topics.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for track stalls, water escapes and smoke or blocked vision; a contrast card on which way to run from the tracks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on escaping a stalled or submerged car.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec10-m01..sec10-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
